text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Mubarak says military hospitals should treat civilians; president opens Fayed military hospital on the 23rd anniversary of October war victory.
- Mubarak meets Irish foreign minister; Moussa says Egypt welcomes Europe's role in Middle East peace process.
- Mubarak, Arafat attend October war celebrations in Ismailia.
- Former holding company boss to be held further 45 days.
- Finance minister tells Ahram income tax will be reduced within days.
- IMF official says Egypt has achieved financial equilibrium by reducing deficit to 1.3 percent.
- Weizman to visit Egypt next week for talks with Mubarak.
- Three committees set up to prepare for Cairo economic conference.
- Egypt has exported 310,000 kintar of cotton worth one million pounds to 19 countries over the past four weeks.
- Egypt to send delegations to Saudi Arabia to solve problems of Egyptian workers there.
- Arab League Secretary General Esmat Abdel-Meguid says on Arab child day that First Lady Suzanne Mubarak is keen to provide proper care for children.
